name: EasyPost
tagline: Multi-carrier shipping labels, rates, and tracking API
description: EasyPost provides a unified REST API for creating shipping labels, comparing rates, tracking packages, and managing addresses across major carriers. Developers use test and production API keys; test mode does not generate real labels or charges. Common integration path: verify address, get rates, buy a shipment, then track delivery.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth: API key as username, empty password (e.g. curl -u YOUR_API_KEY:). Separate test and production keys from the dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free test mode (no real labels); production free tier and usage fees not fully confirmed as of research — see pricing page for current plan details
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go and higher tiers; label and carrier fees vary by carrier and volume

use_cases: create a shipping label for a package
compare multi-carrier shipping rates for a shipment
track a package by tracking number or shipment id
verify and standardize a shipping address
buy the cheapest or fastest rate for a shipment
list or retrieve recent shipments and tracking events
